source_access_note: Eight Oxford English dictionary entries directly opened; no exact-sense C1 CEFR badge observed. Cambridge direct access HTTP 403; no Cambridge CEFR assertion. Research alternatives are self-drafted, not human-independent signoffs.

original.english_definition: A division between two contrasting ideas or groups.
original.burmese_meaning: ဆန့်ကျင်ကွဲပြားသော အယူအဆ သို့မဟုတ် အုပ်စုနှစ်ခုအကြား ခွဲခြားမှု
original.example_sentence: The debate revealed a dichotomy between growth and conservation.

publisher_evidence.note: Oxford headword definition, POS and pronunciation inspected; footer topic/Word-of-the-Day labels are not exact-sense CEFR evidence.

entries.editorial_finding: Oxford: formal usually-singular contrast between sharply opposed groups. Frozen growth/conservation example risks suggesting an exhaustive binary despite possible compromise.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: A marked division or contrast between two opposing groups or ideas.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: ဆန့်ကျင်ဘက်ဖြစ်သော အုပ်စု သို့မဟုတ် အယူအဆ နှစ်ခုအကြား ထင်ရှားသည့် ကွဲပြားမှု
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The policy draws a dichotomy between eligible and ineligible applicants.

original.english_definition: To spread information or ideas widely among people.
original.burmese_meaning: သတင်းအချက်အလက် သို့မဟုတ် အယူအဆများကို လူအများထံ ကျယ်ကျယ်ပြန့်ပြန့် ဖြန့်ဝေသည်
original.example_sentence: The health agency worked to disseminate clear advice.

publisher_evidence.note: Oxford headword definition, POS and pronunciation inspected; footer topic/Word-of-the-Day labels are not exact-sense CEFR evidence.

entries.editorial_finding: Oxford: formal transitive verb with information/knowledge as object; not generic physical distribution.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: To spread information or knowledge so that it reaches many people.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: သတင်းအချက်အလက် သို့မဟုတ် အသိပညာကို လူအများထံ ကျယ်ကျယ်ပြန့်ပြန့် ဖြန့်ဝေသည်
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The university disseminated its findings to local schools.

original.english_definition: Combining ideas or styles from many different sources.
original.burmese_meaning: ရင်းမြစ်အမျိုးမျိုးမှ အယူအဆ သို့မဟုတ် ပုံစံများကို ပေါင်းစပ်ထားသော
original.example_sentence: The café has an eclectic collection of furniture.

publisher_evidence.note: Oxford headword definition, POS and pronunciation inspected; footer topic/Word-of-the-Day labels are not exact-sense CEFR evidence.

entries.editorial_finding: Oxford: selecting from varied styles or ideas, not simply possessing many items.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: Selecting or combining styles or ideas from a wide variety of sources.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: ပုံစံ သို့မဟုတ် အယူအဆ အမျိုးမျိုးမှ ရွေးချယ်ပေါင်းစပ်ထားသော
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The exhibition displayed an eclectic mix of modern and traditional art.

original.english_definition: The ability of a treatment or method to produce the intended result.
original.burmese_meaning: ကုသမှု သို့မဟုတ် နည်းလမ်းတစ်ခုက ရည်ရွယ်ထားသည့် ရလဒ်ကို ဖြစ်စေနိုင်စွမ်း
original.example_sentence: Researchers evaluated the efficacy of the new training method.

publisher_evidence.note: Oxford headword definition, POS and pronunciation inspected; footer topic/Word-of-the-Day labels are not exact-sense CEFR evidence.

entries.editorial_finding: Oxford: uncountable formal noun, capacity to achieve desired result; distinguish effectiveness from efficiency. OPAL W is not a CEFR badge.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: The ability of a treatment or method to achieve the intended result.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: ကုသမှု သို့မဟုတ် နည်းလမ်းတစ်ခုက ရည်ရွယ်ထားသည့် ရလဒ်ကို ရရှိစေနိုင်သည့် ထိရောက်မှု
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: Researchers tested the efficacy of the new teaching method.

original.english_definition: To add details to make a story or object more attractive, sometimes less accurate.
original.burmese_meaning: ဇာတ်လမ်း သို့မဟုတ် အရာတစ်ခုကို ပိုဆွဲဆောင်မှုရှိစေရန် အသေးစိတ်အချက်များ ထပ်ဖြည့်သည်
original.example_sentence: He tended to embellish his stories with dramatic details.

publisher_evidence.note: Oxford headword definition, POS and pronunciation inspected; footer topic/Word-of-the-Day labels are not exact-sense CEFR evidence.

entries.editorial_finding: Oxford separates object decoration from adding potentially untrue story details. Frozen definition merges senses; frozen example is story sense.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: To make an account more interesting by adding details that may not be true.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: ပြောပြချက်တစ်ခုကို ပိုစိတ်ဝင်စားဖွယ်ဖြစ်စေရန် အမှန်မဟုတ်နိုင်သော အသေးစိတ်အချက်များ ထပ်ဖြည့်ပြောသည်
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The witness embellished his account with details he could not verify.

original.english_definition: Regularly found in a particular area or population.
original.burmese_meaning: ဒေသ သို့မဟုတ် လူအုပ်စုတစ်ခုတွင် ပုံမှန်တွေ့ရှိရသော
original.example_sentence: The disease is endemic in several tropical regions.

publisher_evidence.note: Oxford headword definition, POS and pronunciation inspected; footer topic/Word-of-the-Day labels are not exact-sense CEFR evidence.

entries.editorial_finding: Oxford: persistent occurrence in a location/group; species-specific 'endemic to' means only found there. Frozen disease example uses former.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: Regularly present in a particular region or population.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: ဒေသတစ်ခု သို့မဟုတ် လူအုပ်စုတစ်ခုတွင် ပုံမှန် ဆက်လက်တွေ့ရှိရသော
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The infection is endemic in several rural districts.

original.english_definition: A person or thing that is difficult to understand or explain.
original.burmese_meaning: နားလည်ရန် သို့မဟုတ် ရှင်းပြရန် ခက်ခဲသော လူ သို့မဟုတ် အရာ
original.example_sentence: The disappearance of the records remains an enigma.

publisher_evidence.note: Oxford headword definition, POS and pronunciation inspected; footer topic/Word-of-the-Day labels are not exact-sense CEFR evidence.

entries.editorial_finding: Oxford: mysterious person, thing or situation, not any ordinary difficulty. Missing records example plausible but needs mystery sense.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: A mysterious person, thing or situation that is difficult to understand.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: နားလည်ရန် သို့မဟုတ် ရှင်းပြရန် ခက်ခဲသော ပဟေဠိဆန်သည့် လူ၊ အရာ သို့မဟုတ် အခြေအနေ
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The reason for the sudden shutdown remains an enigma.

original.english_definition: Lasting for only a very short time.
original.burmese_meaning: အချိန်အလွန်တိုတောင်းစွာသာ တည်ရှိသော
original.example_sentence: The artist used ice to create an ephemeral sculpture.

publisher_evidence.note: Oxford headword definition, POS and pronunciation inspected; footer topic/Word-of-the-Day labels are not exact-sense CEFR evidence.

entries.editorial_finding: Oxford: lasting or used for a short period. Ice sculpture example fits; not synonymous with fragile or disposable.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: Lasting or being used for only a short time.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: အချိန်တိုတောင်းစွာသာ တည်တံ့သော သို့မဟုတ် အသုံးပြုသော
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The beauty of the ice sculpture was ephemeral.
